amendment_before_sampling: MagentaSparrow ruling #437 requires a comparison where the floor can bind. The version1 draft was not committed or sampled. The false-control budgets are amended from3/epsilon to1/epsilon; the full-budget redundancy is retained as a derived result, not sampled evidence.
seed_policy: fresh gate-owned entropy, committed after hypothesis and protocol, hashed into run registration before any sampling; never caller-supplied or selected after outcomes
sampler: R4 uniform_integer rejection sampler; its source identity is pinned in each run registration; pseudorandom uniform-word assumption is explicit
failure_coding: X=0 only for a validated SURVIVED_TRIAL; X=1 only for a verified COUNTEREXAMPLE; incomplete, budget-exceeded, failed, or unverified executions are not clean cases
comparison_schedule: completed declared hunt budgets of1/epsilon, below the maximum-stake clean threshold at alpha=1/20; not interim prefixes of a longer hunt
decision_rule: adopt iff at least one completed SURVIVED planted-false hunt has final E < 20; otherwise drop for this comparison. KILLED already denies and INCOMPLETE has no clean admission. An adoption still requires reviewed bundle-configured Tier-2 proving-only wiring before bead close.
reproduction: fresh uncached executor/verifier attempt reruns on original recipes, real substrate reproducibility records, resampling original committed nonce and matching canonical X/E transcript; not a second statistical sample

derived_redundancy.statement: For epsilon=1/N and fixed maximum stake, a clean n-case prefix has exact E=(N/(N-1))^n. At n=3N, -3N*log(1-1/N)>3, hence E>e^3>20. Verified failures already kill the hunt. No sampling is needed to establish redundancy at budgets3N.
derived_redundancy.verification: Exact rational comparison checks (N/(N-1))^(n-1)<20 and (N/(N-1))^n>=20 for each row. This is derived arithmetic, not an in-repository Lean proof or sampled experiment result.

design_limit: At the false controls' completed budgets N, a clean hunt has E near e and below20, so a false conjecture that survives the hunt can be additionally denied by the floor. One fresh run per control can still yield only KILLED outcomes and a drop under the decision rule. Decisions concern these synthetic D and budgets only, not utility at other stakes, distributions, budgets, or resource schedules.
no_claim: No promotion, reward, universality, Lean proof, or family-wide inference. Synthetic controls are fixtures, not external mathematics findings. The floor remains unwired unless the preregistered adoption criterion is met.
